summary.name: Equinox
summary.one_liner: Equinox is a free, open-source macOS app for creating dynamic desktop wallpapers that change over the day based on sun position, a set time, or light/dark appearance.
use_cases: Create a macOS dynamic desktop that follows sunrise and sunset
Make a wallpaper that changes at chosen times of day
Set separate light and dark mode wallpapers for macOS
Build a custom Dynamic Desktop without using Apple's default options
summary.what_it_does: ["Equinox creates macOS dynamic wallpapers, the kind introduced with Dynamic Desktop and Light and Dark Desktop in macOS Mojave.", "Solar mode changes the desktop picture across the day based on the sun's calculated position in the sky.", "Time mode changes the picture based on times the user chooses.", "Appearance mode uses two images, one for light mode and one for dark mode, switching with the system appearance.", "A solar calculator lets the user pick a location to run the solar calculations in one place."]
notable: Three wallpaper types: solar, time, and appearance
Built-in solar calculator with location selection
caveats: Works only on macOS, starting with Mojave-style dynamic wallpapers
Appearance mode requires supplying two images (light and dark)
